description: A0 with exactly one change: ensemble.py ATLAS top-2 margin threshold .3 -> .25

change.what: existing inference threshold: ATLAS (Qwen3-8B adapter) rescoring is applied to rows whose top-2 prior margin is < threshold (only when the test has >= 50 rows; smaller tests rescore every row, unchanged)
change.why: Lowering the threshold restricts the 0.9/0.1 ATLAS mix to the most ambiguous rows, testing whether ATLAS helps only near the decision boundary; it also reduces ATLAS runtime, the largest per-row cost on the hidden test.
